answer: A harbor wharf cannot forge trust by counting its own ships twice. Give each identity reward weight only for fresh counterparties: each epoch, credit comes solely from work for counterparties it has never served, verified by independent signed receipts. Repeat business decays to zero weight, so a Sybil ring trading among its own puppets earns nothing new. Like a nebula gathering new matter to shine, an identity must keep winning real strangers. The attacker pays real outreach and delivery for every puppet, every epoch; honest agents reuse one history across many epochs.
